nom: PEACH & LILY MiniProtein Exosome Bioactive Ampoule

avis.titre: Love it's the best just buy it
avis.texte: Works great!! No reactions. I have sensitive dermatitis skin and this doesn't give me any issues. Skin is so glowy I use the toner dew essence as well daily

This lotion is great when you want peptides for anti-aging. It has many peptides and plant extracts. It is light but still just a bit greasy. It does not make me break out. It smells slightly like fresh coconuts. It does not have niacinamide, allantoin, bakuchiol or retinol so you can layer this with other anti-aging lotions that have those ingredients.

I was worried to try this - it seemed like something that low key might not do anything for my skin. But I've been using it on areas where my skin barrier is weak and dry. It is helping keep my skin moisturized on a daily basis. Not sure if its a long term fix or more of a temporary delivery of moisture but I can feel and see a difference using it

This was my first peach and lily product and I am blown away. The concentrated formula is powerful and makes my skin glow. I've been using this for a few weeks now and absolutely notice an improvement in skin texture. Peach and Lily hooked me.

avis.titre: Peach & Liky is a very go
avis.texte: Peach & Liky is a very good peptide serum for the price. This is my third bottle; it always makes my skin plump & hydrated.
Love this new serum. It goes on silky and light and my skin drinks it up. My skin has been glowy and bouncy since the first application. Love it!

Took me a long time before I tried this because I didnt think I needed it, I've been pretty satisfied with all the products I've been using from peach and lily. At my age, I get a lot of compliments on my skin and people think I'm a lot younger I tell them about peach and lily and how it's really changed me from having adult acne and dull skin and scarring , to clear glowing youthful skin. I have to say this has elevated my skin to the point where I didn't even know I needed it. What a wonderful addition! This will be a part of my routine from now on.

I used this for a while and saw a change in my skin that I liked. I took a pause and my skin returned to the way it had been looking before I used the serum. Started using it again to see if my skin would improve (though there is also a weather change with Spring which also impacts my skins overall condition fjor the better) after two weeks--- with consistent use---I see positive changes in overall clarity and texture/lines (lines not gone completely but improved). The changes are subtle......but I see them.
Great product that leaves a dewy finish! The serum is lightweight while feeling plush, very excited to see what results I get with constant usage :heart:️

avis.titre: I would and have bought this product again
avis.texte: I love this stuff makes my skin smooth and soft and does not irritate it. I give it a 10

I'm a devout Glass Skin Serum user. This caused pore clogs on my cheek where I'm prone to them, so I avoid that area. Using on necklace lines and eye area mostly. Bought to use pm for extra hydration. It does add some, but not enough for my dry skin so the search continues.

I decided to try this to see how it worked on my fine lines. The application feels so silky! I am still unsure what my long term results are but daily I am very happy with how glowy it is on my skin and the smoothness of the formula.

It's almost certainly doing what it says on the box, because I just had a baby and my skin looks great except for wicked dark circles (not the focus of this product anyway). When I don't use it my smile lines show back up. The only problem I have with it is a vague plastic-y scent on application, but I can ignore it because of how hydrating it is and how soothed my skin feels after use. I can feel it locking in all the other products and it makes my skin look so smooth.
All I can say is wow. This stuff works. My skin looks brighter and balanced. My skin feels bouncy and soft. Will repurchase.

I was quite skeptical at first because I didn't have the best experience layering some other P&L products with my holy grail P&L routine but this fit in perfectly. I didn't think it would get better (currently using retinal + glass serum) and this made my skin, soft and supple without breaking me out. Typically I don't get a good outcome when layering too many products (more than 2) but was pleasant surprised! Will repurchase!
I saw lots of reviews on this product and had to try it myself for my mature skin. Makes my face so hydrated and young looking!!! So glad I tried it!!! You need this in your skincare routine!!!
This is super moisturizing and makes skin look plump. Works well with my day and night routine. A little goes a long way
My favorite product from peach and lily. Easy to put on, feels so smooth and leaves the face shiny and hydrated.

avis.titre: Unfortunately not for sensitive or acne prone
avis.texte: I loved how it made my face feel and the glow it gave me but unfortunately it did make me breakout in a bunch of tiny whiteheads all over.
Non greasy smooth product that has helped to reduce wrinkles. This product is part of my weekly routine. Love it

If you can only buy one thing at Peach and Lily, this is it! My face has looked a lot smoother and firmer since I started using it. And my cheeks are a lot rounder. This product works so well, I feel comfortable not using makeup most of the time anymore.
this helped my face recover from some chemo treatment to my face.
I love how youthful this makes my skin. It visibly erases fine lines, and hydrates skin. For my skin it's more of a winter serum, while the mini protein (blue) serum is more a summer serum.
Love this serum! It leaves my skin dewy and hydrated with less fine lines!
Hands down my favorite. Leaves my skin glowing. I am prone to eczema but this is so gentle on my skin.

Its not an exageration to say that this is my holy grail product. Im on my 4th bottle and my skin keeps getting better. Every time I go anywhere people say something about my glowing skin. It is wirth every red cent!
Was recommend by a dermatologist I follow. I decided I'd try it once but I've already reordered! An easy add to your skin care routine
I feel a total difference in smoothness. I dont see a difference in lines or wrinkles, but this is only my second bottle.

avis.titre: Broken capillary girlies…pull up a chair
avis.texte: I tried this product in hopes of the plumping and firming benefits related to collagen loss and fine lines. After using this 3 times, I noticed a significant reduction in the visibility of the broken capillaries on my cheeks; this is the only product I've added into my routine. Broken capillaries are a huge pain point for me as no foundation or concealer completely covers them and I've tried laser 3x with no improvement. I was SHOCKED when I looked in the mirror this morning & hardly noticed my broken capillaries at all. I have extremely sensitive/reactive skin and I didn't notice any issues after using this serum twice. I did, however, experience some irritation after the 3rd use, so it seems like using 2x/week is my sweet spot. If you are also sensitive/reactive, I wouldn't be completely warded off by the reviews. The benefits of this product are compounding, so you should still see results even if you need to use it less than someone whose skin can tolerate using it 3+ days a week.
Feels really nice on the skin but its premature to say about skin results

The MiniProtein Exosome Bioactive Ampoule has it all -- it's moisturizing, it's soothing, it's anti-aging, and it feels like silk on your skin. I pair this with the Super Root Ginseng Facial Oil for a powerhouse duo of hydrating anti-aging goodness. Used in the morning and evening, it bookends my day with luxurious moisture that leaves me feeling like my skin is refreshed and nourished.

I have been using this product for a couple weeks now and i pair it with the vitamin c from them and my skin has been radiant. I have received many compliments from coworkers asking what im doing differently. My scarring from old acne has faded and i feel very confident going outside without makeup.

I absolutely love this. It is now a core item in my daily routine. It definitely has made my face feel so smooth and hydrated. It's even reduced my smile lines a little. It just makes my skin feel happy and glow.
Love it - Much improved skin texture and diminished fine lines!
Not sure if long term it does what it advertises but short term it gives my middle aged face a really nice glow so im a fan!
Love this product. I'm on my third order of it since October the only thing I wish they could do different is make it in a larger size.

I've been using this product for a couple weeks, thankfully im still in the return window because although it looks great as soon as you apply I've been noticing small bumps under the skin and irregular redness for me. Its so sad because it makes you so glowy, I even thought it smoothed the lines in my forehead. I did not realize it has coconut derivates like other comments mentioned so maybe that is why. I do have sensitive skin and this product has a lot of ingredients so beware if you have similar skin.
This is one of my favorite products ever, glowy dewy…. I love this
I really like this product not sure if I'm seeing any results from it, but I really like it on my second bottle
Since switching up my skin care routine, my face glows and is noticeably younger. I use the MiniProtein Exosome Bioactive Ampoule every morning as part of my routine.

So i got this product a couple months ago as a free sample and finally decided to try it last week. I used it and immediately loved it. My skin looked so nice the next day. As i continued to use it though my skin was getting super red and hot every single night even when i skipped using it some nights. I realized yesterday this either destroyed my skin barrier or just some type of reaction. I had to return it today sadly. (I love peach and lily btw)
Notice a difference in even tone, light weight and non clogging like most white hued products.

I have been using this am and pm for about a month. 3 days after I started using it I was getting compliments from friends on how glowy I look. I have Autoimmune diseases that make my skin dry, having hydrated skin is difficult. This has made a massive difference and I notice if I skip it. My husband, who hates using lotion on his face, has started using it and likes it. It is lightweight, and I haven't had an issue using under lotion, spf, or makeup. My only con is that its expensive. I wish you got a little more product for the price. I'll continue to buy it as long as I can afford it

Unlike any other skin care product I have ever used. And I have tried a lot. This will be a forever stable in my skin care routine. I use it after all of my serums, and before my moisturizer. It's the only skin care or makeup item I have on auto ship!!!

I was recommended this product by an Ulta employeee and i'm actually very satisfied with this serum. I have sensitive skin and it didn't give me a rash or chemical burn. It leaves my skin feeling soft and plump. It's pricey but worth it.
Hands down the most effective serum I have ever used, and I have spent sooooo much money on skincare.

This was my absolute favorite loved it. I just reordered it on peach & lily and I think that formula has changed. I loved the smell of this it was so nice light almost coconut I think, now nothing. I wish I had enough of my last bottle to compare the consistency etc but I opened this when it was gone. I am sad and I ordered 2 bottles so I guess I will need to determine if I want to send this back. I love peach and Lilly but this is the second purchase in 2 months that has been disappointing.

avis.titre: Feels Amazing but Not for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: The texture is amazing and feel silky soft when applying. However, I have sensitive skin and coconut is not sensitive skin friendly. It broke me out with just one use horribly bad. Took a week to calm my skin down. Broke my heart b/c it has such promising ingredients (minus the coconut) and the application so soothing and silky soft (until the next day).

avis.titre: Absolutely love this exosome product. It makes my skin glow.
avis.texte: Wonderful product. It is creamy and light and makes my skin glow. It is the first thing on in the morning followed by Vit C serum. I apply it at night after cleansing. I notice my skin looks less blotchy, lessening the higher pigmented areas. It has become a staple.
This product exceeded my expectation. Within few days my face texture changed. It's very moisturizing. Best affordable protein exosome. Will continue to restock this product.
This is the absolute best serum. Done wonders for my skin. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: I have very dry skin, and
avis.texte: I have very dry skin, and this has been a game changer. It adds some extra hydration to my routine and definitely gives me a glow. I look better rested and my skin feels more firm - especially my cheeks. I've been using this for about 6 weeks and feel like I look 5 years younger just from the radiance this adds to my skin. I also love the convenient (and hygenic) pump and the milky texture of it.

avis.titre: New addition to my skin care routine
avis.texte: I just started to incorporate this product into my skincare routine so not yet long enough to see a difference. Plus I'm still figuring out where it fits best in my routine. Time will tell!

I used two free samples of this and bought a full bottle (trying to really give it a true shot) and i just finsihed the full bottle…i see no difference. I feel no difference. Im not sure what im supposed to be seeing, but i havent seen a change in my skin. Perhaps i was usng it wrong, but either way ive seen no change (btw i love peach and lily)

Excited to try this exosome product and it hasn't disappointed! Very hydrating and smoothing but not too creamy. Even in the winter I can use this product to get hydration and not use another cream before I go outside in the cold. I tried another exosome cream at 3x the price and was good but this Peach and Lily product is better at a lower cost.

avis.titre: I love this product. It s
avis.texte: I love this product. It smoothed out my wrinkles quickly and it makes the face shine. It's thin,but creamy and silky.

I have finicky skin. I'm mid 40's and used to have very oily skin but now I'm in full menopause and it's dry and dull. I bought this on a whim and my own husband asked if I've been doing something different with my skin lately. It plumps my skin so fast. I do use it in conjunction with their peptide, firming moisturizer. I doesn't make my skin breakout which I'm prone to. I glow and my 11's aren't as prominent. I'm on my second jar!!

I added this to my lineup a couple of weeks ago, and WOW! I my skin feels amazing and looks plump! I'm 45 with historically oily, acne prone skin, so I tend to steer clear of heavy, heavily fragranced products. This is light, not greasy, not sticky, and absorbs nicely! I'm going to pause on some other products because this seems to do the work of a few of them, and minimizing the lineup would be fantastic!

This stuff is magic. After I'd been using it for just two days, I started noticing that my skin looked great--bright, even, a bit of a glow. It's also incredibly hydrating. I'm on my second bottle, and will continue to purchase as long as they sell it.

This is an amazing product. I apply it before any other product and it sinks right into my skin. Following with Vit C in the morning. My skin looks glowing and the dark spots have faded on my cheeks. Peach and Lily products are high quality and I have been cutting back on Skin Ceuticals due to the high cost and find that I am getting very similar results from the Peach and Lily products.
Love how it makes my skin not dry and tight! Wonderful product and have purchased before.
Leaves my skin so smooth. It's lightweight and not oily. Love!

If there was only 1 product I would have to choose from peach and lily it would be this one. This is my HOLY GRAIL product. I have been using this religiously for a month and have noticed a difference in my cheek volume. I just ran out and saw it was out of stock online so I had to run to Ulta since I can not miss a day of this product.

avis.titre: A solid peptide complex for a good price
avis.texte: I am extremely impressed with this product. This is luxe skincare for a fraction of the price I would expect to pay for in a more premium brand. This product not only visibly reduces inflammation and fine lines overnight, but also repairs the skin barrier and signals collagen production. You get immediate "plumping" results and long term anti-aging benefits. It's like having 2-3 skincare products in one.

I use both the Mini Protein Ampoule and the blue Copper Peptide Serum!They must be working because my 50 year old nephew said he thought I looked 50-55!! I'm 67!!So, YAY!(I can't afford treatments with a dermatologist. )
Really happy with this purchase, goes on nicely and hasn't made me break out. Excited to see results over the next few weeks of use

I've been using this for about a month now and I do notice my fine lines have reduced. It hasn't irritated my skin and leaves a nice moisturized feeling. I'm looking forward to seeing the results over the next few months and will likely re-order.

it's breaking me out. I'm definitely sad bc its a beautiful product. makes the skin look hydrated . not greasy at all. I am sensitive oily acne prone for ref. I say give it a go and hopefully you tolerate it! by the reviews, it seems generally well tolerated

avis.titre: New addition to my routine to address skin concerns
avis.texte: Great to incorporate the new treatment into my routine. I took the advantage of the holiday sale and ordered two bottles so I have enough time to see the results it promises. I have not used it long enough to see a difference yet. The application is smooth and it absorbs well.

I will srart off by saying that I am a skincare junkie- i use a multi step rountine in the morning and evening and skincycle products throughout the week. I try everything. Because I take such good care of my skin, a product has to be AMAZING to see and feel a noticable impact on my skin. This ampoule delivers!!!! This product contains mini proteins, growth factors and exosomes- a trifecta of powerful ingredients to soften skin, combat aging, and restore collagen. This can replace a few serums in my routine. The very first night I used this ampoule, my skin was a new level of softness ij the AM. Made my husband try it too and he was blown away. We now use it daily. Last week someone commented to me that my skin was visibly more youthful. I really want to try other Peach and Lily products considering how amazing the Ampoule is. When I find a product that I love, I am like Oprah and buy it for my friends as one of my favorite things-and this was under the Xmas tree for several family members this year!

I wanted to love this because all the good things about it. First the scent is very coconut like which I am not a fan of. and I got it to use after the retinal serum, everytime I use it either after the serum or by itself my skin just burns and feels irritated. Unfortunately will be returning. I do have sensitive skin but I expected the retinal to be irritating if anything but it doesn't bother me.

I have been shopping at Peach and Lily since 2015, right before I a black woman moved to South Korea. I've tried almost all the products the company has formulated. I sincerely trust the standards this company adheres to. In addition it's rare I do reviews, I just want anyone reading this to understand how much I'd have to like a product to say something. All this goes to say this is my FAVORITE product I have ever bought from Peach and Lily!!!!! I have never gotten results from a product so quickly. The glow is insane and my skin looks plump and refreshed. I have only been using consistently for about a month and I'm head over heels. Literally can't wait to see even more results after more time. BUY THIS!!!!

Ok, this is my new favorite P&L product. Ok, very close second . . . I can't start my skincare routine without my wild dew essence. This is such a fantastic addition to my skin care routine. I add it at the very end, right before my moisturizer and it kind of satruates my skin, pushing everything I just put on my skin into my skin. It feels and looks amazing. LOVE IT!

avis.titre: It's too soon to see full
avis.texte: It's too soon to see full results. I'm almost done with my first bottle. It's a great product. It feels silky on my skin. It gives me a nice shine to my face,glass skin as it's called now. I definitely see an Improvement of my fine lines and my skin is slowly getting an even tone. The areas of hyperpidmentaions are diminishing. I already bought a second bottle and I'll keep buying more so I don't run out. Definitely, a great product to have in your skin routine.

I've only used it a few times and it has made my skin so soft! I have really sensitive skin, so I did break out a little bit the first couple of times I used it, but I have high hopes for this in conjunction with other P&L products
It's more hydrating than I expected. My skin glows and feels nourished

Started using the Ampoule a few months back and I love the difference I both see and feel. The milky consistency melts into my skin and I've had zero reactions (I have sensitive skin). Happy to have found Peach and Lily!
Love this. Super hydrating. Havent been using long enough to notice the other things it claims to help.

When this first came out, I got it immediately from Ulta and I was so excited and I definitely have gone through an entire bottle. I'm on my second bottle and I have a third one ready to go for when the next one is needed. I use it at least once a day. I do my toner, vitamin C Cs, and then I add this on top before sunscreen and moisturizer. My skin definitely glows and I am seeing a very solid improvement and I really think a huge contributor to that is this product. I will definitely worry you purchase in the future not to mention peach and Lilly customer service is top-notch And I have used many of their products but this one is definitely my favorite!!! I'm 39.
This may be my new favorite face cream. My 45 year old skin looks fresh and more lively in just 3 weeks of use.

avis.titre: Great primer for routine skin care
avis.texte: I am 67 and was looking for moisture in my skin routine. I am a redhead with fair skin and this cream was recommended by the Associate with other products in the line. Some days I just wear this alone with face smoothing results. Love this product!
I like everything about this product just can't comment if it is making a difference in my skin. I will say, it's not making it worse so that's good.

This is a game changer. This stuff gives me that glass skin glow. It's hydrating but not thick, absorbs nicely and really did help with overall even skin tone and fine lines. It made my skin look like it rested haha. . I will be buying again.

avis.titre: I wish I could use this, but I can't
avis.texte: I'm sure this is lovely for some people. It has a great texture, no offensive scent and made my skin really hydrated and glowy. But my skin is currenly going through the horrors of perimenopause and it made my hormonal cystic acne 10x worse. I stopped using it 3 weeks ago and I'm still nursing some really bad scars and pimples that remain slighly raised after all that time. If you are prone to hormonal acne, I would think twice before trying this.

avis.titre: Love this so much I order
avis.texte: Love this so much I ordered 2 more bottles immediately. Soft and bouncy, glowy skin!!!
Have only used it for two weeks every night and every other day. I have extremely sensitive mature skin. No irritation at all. Soft, plump hydrated skin.

I have dry, sensitive skin. I added this to my routine for an extra layer of hydration. I loved the milky texture to it. After about 2 months of using twice a day, I actually feel like my skin looks more plump, which I've never experienced with a product. I will keep buying!
I really like this serum. I been applying it every night for about 2weeks. Feels thick but very moisturized on the skin. it's still too early to say if it's working on my fine lines.
Get this on your face! It's absolutely amazing. I'm a week in and the results are unbelievable!

I bought This hoping it would give me glowing skin and it did from the very first use. I don't have a ton of wrinkles yet but it makes the quality of my skin more vibrant and bouncy- If that makes sense. It's definitely worth a try!

I can't sing the praises of this ampoule enough! It's been the biggest game changer when it comes to my tretinoin journey! Not only is it super hydrating, but it's also incredibly calming. I notice it has helped my skin adapt to tret significantly better.

This has made my skin so soft and hydrated, the lines on my forehead are also looking less noticable. It's become my new favorite serum! The only thing I'm not a fan of is the smell, but other than that it's amazing!

avis.titre: Surprised, but this made a positive difference!
avis.texte: I have grown cynical after trying many costly skin care product. THIS product made my skin look smoother, brighter, younger, within a few days. I am impressed. Already on bottle #2
I bought this not expecting much, boy, was I wrong! This product is simply incredible. From the first application, my skin was soft, hydrated and just had an amazing glow! Highly recommended.
I've only been using this for three days, but so far I really like the texture and application. Excited to see how much better my skin looks shortly because I've been rather neglectful.

Age 58, had dry skin even before it became "mature." Psoriatic skin must absorb products differently. Hard to find hydrators and moisturizers that don't just sit on top. Huge fan of Glass Skin Serum so I keep trying other P&L products. Many cause spots for me when layered, but this one is a keeper. First morn woke with with super soft skin. Only day 2 but been seeking extra night moisture that won't cause spots for ages so quite happy. Still deciding whether it needs a basic HA serum underneath. I do layer moisturizer on top.

I have severely combination, acne prone skin. I do not use moisturizers at all, I actually prefer to layer toners, essences, serums, then lock it all in with SPF. I love P&L, so I was super excited to see them launch such an inventive new skincare product - I HAD to get 2 bottles during this recent BF/CM 40% off sale. Nevertheless, winter is here, my skin is extra dry, and I figuded a rich "ampoule" would do me good. Well yall.. I'm here to report back that it is GOOD! The texture is really unique. I wouldnt call this a lotion, an emulsion, or a serum. Its thick without being heavy and sitting on top of your skin. Really, it is heavenly - it actually ABSORBS and plumps up your skin so nicely. One issue I always had with super greasy "hydrating" skincare in the past is how they would cause my foundation to crease. This product does not do that! If I use this as my last step before SPF + IT CC matte foundation, my makeup is flawless and hydrated, sets by itself with no creasing. My advice is that this product functions best on top of an essence and a serum - using it alone would cause you to use up the entire bottle quickly, which is historically a reoccuring theme of P&L products, they are very "product hungry". For example, if you were to use this product on a dry face before a moisturizer and/or SPF, you would have to use 6+ pumps to cover your entire face and neck. Whereas, after prepping skin with my essences and light serums, I only have to use 3 pumps. I have the same is

avis.titre: Truly the best! I have st
avis.texte: Truly the best! I have stocked up as its the best part of my skin care routine and cant be without. So hydrating without being heavy, 0 reactions and i have sensitive reactive skin. The best glow and after finishing my 3rd bottle i have noticed my fine lines softening and generally more firmness.
